checks.name: equal_traces_positive
checks.source:
import S11VariableCoefficients.Controls
open S11VariableCoefficients S10Pilot MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
theorem contract_control (v h : Vec 3) : jumpPair v v h = 0 := matched_trace_zero v h

checks.name: trace_criterion_positive
checks.source:
import S11VariableCoefficients.Controls
open S11VariableCoefficients S10Pilot MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
theorem contract_control (p q : Vec 3) : (∀ h, jumpPair p q h = 0) ↔ p = q := jumpPair_zero_iff p q
